title: Welcome Letter
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM

Welcome Letter

Use

When you create or change a move-in, you can print a correspondence to be sent to the business partner, or generate a print order
for the correspondence. You have the following options:

e Create welcome letter manually
To do this, choose the Welcome letter pushbutton in move-in processing.

e Create welcome letter when data is saved

To have the system create a budget billing plan automatically when you save the move-in document, mark the WL checkbox
(Create welcome letter automatically) in Customizing under |}Move-In/Out » Move-In > Define Move-In Control Parameters at
Document Level.

If necessary, you can also override the settings you have established in Customizing. To do this, choose |sExtras ' Control
Parameters “Jin move-in processing.

When you create a welcome letter, specify an application form of the form class IS_U_CS_MOVE_IN_WELCOME_LETTER. In
addition, you have to define the application form in Customizing under |} Utilities Industry Customer Service » Process
Execution » Move-In/Out » Move-In » Define Welcome Letter » . You can find more information on creating an application
form in the section on the “Print Workbench component.

Screen Layout

Use

In Customizing under |}Vove-In » Configure Tabs for Move-In Screen 3, you can configure various views for the data on the
move-in screen.These views are composed of tabs that you can use to organize the data into different logical units based on your
requirements.

You can maintain contract data in one of two ways:

e Individual maintenance
The system displays the data of one contract only.
e Overview maintenance
The system displays the data of up to five move-in documents allocated to the same contract.

For more information, see Customizing under |}}Move-In/Out Define System Parameters for Move-In and Move-Out

You can include standard and user-defined fields for the contract account and business partner in direct maintenance. To do this,
use the following enhancements:

e EMBPOO3 (user subscreen in the business partner subscreen for move-in/out))

e EMDCAOO]I (user subscreen for IS-U contract account)
